title: Latency regression harness + dashboards (p95/p99) segmented by route/model/region
creator: Iris Kim
description: Add end-to-end p95/p99 latency collection, storage, regression detection, and Console dashboards broken down by route, model, and region. This ticket ties together the load-testing harness (tokens/sec and synthetic traffic), the metrics ingestion pipeline, and Console dashboard components so product teams and SREs can spot regressions early and understand unit economics impact per traffic slice. The work includes metric instrumentation, aggregation rollups, query patterns, alerting rules, and a small design for dashboard UX (filtering, heatmaps, and sparklines).
acceptance_criteria: p95 and p99 latency metrics are emitted and stored with tags: route, model, model_variant, region, and deployment_id
Console contains a new Performance -> Latency Insights page with: filter bar (route/model/region), table of current p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec, per-minute heatmap, and time-series panels
Regression detection running daily and on each synthetic load test; alerts created when p95 or p99 exceeds adaptive threshold or increases >25% over historical baseline
Load-testing harness annotations (test-id, tokens/sec, synthetic=true) are visible on dashboard time axis and associated with detected regressions
Backfill of aggregated p95/p99 for last 90 days available for baseline computations
tech_notes: Metrics pipeline: extend existing latency histogram instrumentation to include finer buckets for long tails and add labels (route, model, variant, region). Write raw histogram samples to Cortex (Prometheus remote write) and compute per-minute quantiles using a rollup job into ClickHouse for fast p95/p99 queries. Use an aggregation lambda (k8s job) that consumes from the metrics topic, computes streaming TDigest per slice and writes rollups. Add APIs to query by arbitrary slices and time ranges. For alerting, implement adaptive thresholds based on exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) of p95 and p99 with a configurable multiplier, plus relative-change rules. Keep implementation backwards-compatible with existing per-route latency panels. Instrument the load-testing harness to emit 'synthetic.test_id' and 'tokens_per_sec' metrics so tests can be correlated with latency spikes.
implementation_steps: 1) Instrument servers to emit histogram buckets + labels (route, model, region, variant)
2) Add rollup worker that computes per-minute p50/p95/p99 and writes to ClickHouse table latency_rollups
3) Update metrics ingestion manifests and RBAC for rollup worker
4) Extend load-testing harness (harness repo) to emit annotations and tokens/sec metrics
5) Build Console UI: Latency Insights page + dashboard widgets + heatmap component
6) Implement regression detection service that runs daily and on test completion; wire to PagerDuty and Slack alerts
7) Backfill historical rollups for 90 days and validate baselines
8) Docs: runbook for SREs and short Confluence guide for PMs/Design
test_plan: Unit tests for rollup worker quantile computation (TDigest fuzz tests)
Integration tests that send synthetic traffic, assert emitted labels and rollup rows
End-to-end test: run harness at 100 tokens/sec and 500 tokens/sec, validate dashboard shows annotations and regression detection triggers when we inject latency
Canary rollout of rollup worker to staging region; monitor token ingestion, rollup latency, and query correctness
Load test the rollup pipeline itself (peak retention and write qps) and ensure <30s rollup latency
